import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb.active
headers=[ws.cell(row=1,column=c).value for c in range(1,7)]
headers=[str(h).strip() for h in headers]
for r in range(8,15):
    vals=[]
    for c in range(1,7):
        v=ws.cell(row=r,column=c).value
        if str(v).strip().upper()=='Y':
            vals.append(headers[c-1])
    ws.cell(row=r,column=7).value=', '.join(vals)
wb.save(p)
print('done')
